about: Report seam tie-out suite for the Daily Sales PBIP, run by seam.ps1 against the open Desktop model. Each check evaluates two DAX scalar expressions, 'report' (the report's own measures or model state) and 'independent' (a query straight over the fact and date tables, or the expected constant), and fails when they differ. A blank on either side fails the check, unless the check sets 'blankExpected': true, which passes only when both sides are blank. So an existence check compares a non-blank condition (NOT ISBLANK ( ... ) against TRUE ()) or a count ending in + 0, never two values that could both be blank. Expressions may be a string or an array of lines. 'tolerance' is an absolute difference allowed between numbers (default 0). 'fingerprint' is evaluated after each of two data refreshes, and the two results must match.
